hero.description: A prestigious Islamic institution nurturing scholars, character, and faith in the heart of Ramanagara.

about.subtitle: "For years, Madrasa-e-Madeenatul Uloom has served as a sanctuary of Quranic scholarship, Islamic values, character development, and selfless community empowerment in Ramanagara."
about.pillarsSubtitle: The spiritual foundations guiding every student and scholar.

milestones.title: Foundation of MMU Trust
milestones.desc: Founded under the noble guidance of Shri Haji Syed Muneer to build a strong educational foundation and welfare network in Ramanagara.

milestones.title: Beginning of Quranic Education
milestones.desc: Commenced dedicated Nazira and Hifz classes, introducing a rigorous curriculum of Tajweed (pronunciation) and spiritual refinement.

milestones.title: Hundreds of Students Educated
milestones.desc: Expanded capacity to host hundreds of children. Our doors remain open to all students, offering education, lodging, and books entirely free.

milestones.title: Community Development Initiatives
milestones.desc: Launched extensive community outreach drives, distributing food packets, support resources, and hosting civic engagement programs.

milestones.title: Modern Digital Integration
milestones.desc: Incorporating modern computer literacy programs and digital tools alongside our traditional curriculum, preparing scholars for contemporary leadership.

ilm.title: ILM
ilm.label: — Knowledge —
ilm.desc: The foundation of all action and insight. We cultivate rigorous Quranic scholarship alongside secular wisdom to develop enlightened minds.

imaan.title: IMAAN
imaan.label: — Faith —
imaan.desc: Connecting the heart to the Creator. We nurture deep spiritual conviction and moral integrity, modeling life after the beautiful Sunnah.

ikhlaas.title: IKHLAAS
ikhlaas.label: — Sincerity —
ikhlaas.desc: Purity of intent in every endeavor. We instill the mindset that all study, teaching, and community service must be performed solely for the sake of Allah.

quran.translation: Say, 'Are those who know equal to those who do not know?'
quran.explanation: Knowledge elevates a believer. The Quran repeatedly emphasizes that those endowed with knowledge possess a deeper understanding of reality, spiritual direction, and a higher standing before Allah.

hadith.translation: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
hadith.explanation: Acquiring knowledge is not a luxury or optional pursuit in Islam; it is an active spiritual duty binding on every individual, regardless of gender or social status.

reflection.text: Knowledge (Ilm) is the foundation of action. Without understanding, worship lacks depth and character lacks direction. At MMU, we make high-quality Islamic learning accessible to everyone through professional scholars.

quran.translation: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts become fearful.
quran.explanation: True faith (Imaan) is not merely a verbal statement; it is a profound emotional state that softens the heart, creating awe and reverence whenever Allah is remembered.

hadith.translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
hadith.explanation: Genuine faith is inextricably linked to how we treat others. Seeking success, safety, and guidance for our fellow brothers and sisters is a core parameter of Imaan.

reflection.text: Faith (Imaan) is a seed that must be watered with action and community service. We foster a supportive environment where students cultivate deep personal connection with their Creator and display empathy for humanity.

quran.translation: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, being sincere to Him in religion.
quran.explanation: Every act of worship must be directed solely to Allah. Sincerity (Ikhlaas) is the spiritual filter that ensures our religious deeds are accepted and free from ostentation.

hadith.explanation: The value of any deed lies in the underlying intention. A simple worldly action performed with a pure intention can earn immense reward, while a spiritual deed done for show has no value.

reflection.text: Sincerity (Ikhlaas) is the soul of our actions. We teach our students to continuously audit their intentions, seeking only the pleasure of Allah in their learning, teaching, and serving journeys.

whyUs.heading: Built Upon Four Timeless Pillars
whyUs.description: Every student who walks through our doors benefits from a carefully balanced foundation of scholarship, accessibility, structured learning, and Islamic character.
whyUs.bottomTagline: These are not subjects we teach. They are values we live.

pillars.label: Scholarship
pillars.title: Expert Ustaads
pillars.subtitle: Trained For Excellence.
pillars.desc: Our educators are qualified scholars who bring deep traditional understanding and academic rigor, ensuring proper guidance for every student.

pillars.label: Accessibility
pillars.title: Knowledge For Everyone
pillars.subtitle: No Child Left Behind.
pillars.desc: We believe sacred learning should be open to all. Thanks to generous community backing, we offer fully subsidized, free basic education.

pillars.label: Learning
pillars.title: Structured Path To Excellence
pillars.subtitle: Milestones Of Growth.
pillars.desc: Our curriculum leads students from basic alphabets and Tajweed to complete memorization and deep comprehension across key languages.

pillars.label: Character
pillars.title: Building Future Leaders
pillars.subtitle: Values Over Subjects.
pillars.desc: Education is incomplete without Adab (character). We nurture moral values, self-discipline, and community service in a safe environment.

programs.title: Our Spiritual Programs
programs.desc: Discover a program tailored for your child's spiritual and intellectual growth.

hifz.title: Tahfeez-ul-Qur'an
hifz.desc: A dedicated track for the complete memorization of the Holy Qur'an with rigorous emphasis on Tajweed rules and daily revision schedules.
hifz.curriculum: Curriculum: Memorization, Tajweed, basic Aqeedh, daily supplications (Duas).

alim.title: Alim Course
alim.desc: A comprehensive 6-year theology program covering advanced Arabic grammar, Hadith literature, Quranic exegesis (Tafseer), and jurisprudence (Fiqh).
alim.curriculum: Curriculum: Classical Arabic, Tafseer, Hadith, Usool-al-Fiqh, Islamic History.

deenyat.title: Part-Time Deenyat
deenyat.desc: Evening classes designed for school-going children to acquire essential Islamic knowledge, moral values, and basic Quranic reading skills.
deenyat.curriculum: Curriculum: Noorani Qaida, Urdu reading, Islamic beliefs, Adab (Etiquette).

gallery.title: Glimpses of MMU
gallery.desc: Explore moments of learning, devotion, and community life at Madrasa e Madeenatul Uloom.
